changes: All desktop, tablet, and mobile navigation groups now use one clean single-open dropdown pattern; Home stays first and selection menus share the same accessible visual language
Notebook & PDF Reader now opens a real responsive web reader with Home and full-screen controls on Windows and Android tablets
The learner can choose a 15, 30, or 45 minute daily route; every route includes Grammar Lab, Mixed Practice, Conversation Studio, Review, and Automatization with exact time and workload allocations
Home is now the first persistent navigation action on every page, including Conversation Studio and responsive tablet or mobile layouts
Every English page now follows the supplied white-and-violet reference system and remains structurally clean at desktop, tablet, and mobile widths
A same-origin local API bridge and LAN launcher let Windows and Android browsers use the host PC without installation
Page analytics now separates requested entries from rendered pages, validates and repairs local route data, and presents every route in compact accessible dropdowns
Conversation Studio now exposes a keyboard skip link and all audited routes retain one main landmark without horizontal overflow
Shared selects, accordions, progress indicators, and buttons now use Base UI primitives for consistent focus, keyboard navigation, dismissal, and ARIA behavior across every page

Every learner-facing page now uses an Apple-inspired system layer with calmer materials, clearer hierarchy, anchored menus, immediate press feedback, and reduced-motion, reduced-transparency, and increased-contrast fallbacks
A privacy-first Page Analytics dashboard audits all 21 learner-facing routes using local route attempts and clearly marks unavailable production KPIs as N/A
Progress now has its own evidence-focused page instead of repeating the daily mission
A hybrid four-skill coach combines transparent local NLP observations with optional provider-backed AI repair and transfer prompts; neither path awards CEFR, mastery, pronunciation, or automaticity
A license-reviewed English/German open-dataset catalog now maps listening, speaking, reading, and writing to suitable neural or transparent methods without bundling large corpora
Safe local importers normalize user-downloaded Common Voice and Tatoeba CC0 files while discarding contributor identifiers and demographic fields

Task Definition versioning and lifecycle monitoring: source-only foundation work landed in this release (SQL schema, domain package, deterministic upcasting logic). Not yet wired into the running API or installer -- no learner-facing behavior changed.
Daily Training and Automaticity Mission now appear as one Today’s Practice route
An original visual conversation coach with clearer speaking states
Integrated Skills speaking lessons now open with the correct lesson context
Original listening scripts have normal-speed and slow playback
App updates wait for the learner's permission
Responsive layouts and current learning pages are included in the Windows installer
The installer closes automatically and opens the updated application
